records.subject: Quick check-in from Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Mia,

Quick note to see how things are going. A lot of teams get stuck at the same step -- inviting teammates -- so if that's where you are, happy to walk through it.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Mia,

Your workspace for Bright Dynamics is ready to go. The single highest-leverage thing in week one is creating a real project rather than a test one -- it's what makes the first week actually useful.

I'm here if anything's unclear.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

decisions.rationale: 6 days in, no project, no invite, no key milestone, and zero replies to two outreach emails (email:07ed5ac5, email:acf3be98). No tickets or any customer-side signal of engagement. Silent, fully unstarted accounts rarely self-activate in the remaining 8 days, though Pro paid status leaves some chance.

draft.subject: One next step in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Mia,

Following up on my last note — I know a new workspace is easy to set aside in a busy week.

If it's useful, the in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project; projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. When you're ready to bring the team in, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm glad to sit with you while you set up your first real project, or to answer anything over email.

Best,
Priya
